added_claim_errors: "이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)" is wrong. The key puts this request's Friday at 2026-10-23, so every date-dependent step is off by a week.

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다" is wrong or unverified. An internet-registry 확정일자 filed after 18시 is granted on the next business day, and the 신고일 of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unconfirmed. Stated as certain.
"평일 18시까지" is given as a general fact, but resident-center hours vary by 동. Minor.
"짐을 다 들이지 않아도, 열쇠를 받아 쓸 수 있으면 '인도'는 됩니다" is a legal assertion with no case cited. Plausible but unverified.
The "전입세대 열람" step for 선순위 세입자 is stated without checking who may request it or when. Plausible but unverified.
"대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터라 오전에 끝내는 게 좋아요" has a weak rationale. The 0시 start is the same whether the filing is in the morning or the afternoon.
The HUG conditions are sourced to a third-party site (property.ambitstock.com), and the "2026. 10. 기준" label is unverifiable. The conditions themselves match the key.
The extras (증액 재계약 시 확정일자 재취득, 경매 시 배당요구, 다가구 선순위 보증금) are generally correct, so no error is listed.

reasons: B is better because it has no outright factual error, while A has two. A names the Friday as 10월 30일, but the key's Friday is 10-23. A also says that after 18시 the 정부24 and 인터넷등기소 route can finish "그날 안에", which contradicts the key: an online 확정일자 filed after hours is dated the next business day. Both answers correct the two baited premises at the start, separate 대항력 from 우선변제권, and give the 다음 날 0시 rule. Both give 주민센터 전입신고 plus 확정일자 with 계약서 원본, 신분증 and 600원. Both skip 최우선변제 and the 10-24 date. B adds the explicit "둘 다 이사 당일", a recheck right after 잔금, HUG conditions that match the key, keeping residence for the whole term, and the 6천만 원 임대차 신고 duty with its 30-day limit (though not the 의제 rule). A is shorter and fits "짧게 정리" better, but B's accuracy and fuller coverage of the key outweigh its extra length.
